profile.headline: Microsoft | ex-Amazon | Top 6 North Central MAA - Jerry Heuer | Computer Science & Mathematics | MLH Fellow
profile.summary:
https://dave-portfolio-two.vercel.app/
I'm a SWE at Microsoft, working with C++ and Rust. Besides that, I've participated in competitive programming ICPC, Mathematics Olympiad, North Central Regional Mathematics Competition, Data Science competitions, and scientific research. I'm also interested in low-level programming and Machine Learning

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Microsoft Azure Core Team - Azure Boost
- Working on Azure Boost: Moving Azure infrastructure off the host to dedicated hardware cards, reduce 20% overhead costs on every server, and increase sellable cores using Rust, C++, Linux
- C++ & Rust
positions.insights: Skills: Rust · C++ · Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Created APIs in Rust to manage the lowest-level agents in Azure architecture, including version switch and base image update. My work has been integrated to official system and running in the production on the daily basis
- Our team managed the lowest-level services of the Azure Core architecture to optimize resource allocation and performance, managing OS image deployment across 4 million servers across data centers in Rust and C++
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Rust · Operating Systems · Linux

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:

- Deployed to the pipeline and added unit and Integration testing to make sure the code is scalable and has 95% test coverage
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Development · Computer Vision · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Deep Learning · TypeScript · Hardware

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
SotaTek is the top blockchain company in Asia specializing in creating innovative blockchain platforms.
At SotaTek, I used a low-level language Rust to develop the blockchain core and helped deploy blockchain trading platforms that are used in 10 countries and build an e-wallet to transfer top cryptocurrencies such as Polygon or Solana.

- Built and deployed a blockchain trading platform for 10,000 users from 20 countries to track, chart, and trade crypto tokens
- Increased the table’s query speed by 20% by applying Many-to-many Relationships and TypeORM features for 30,000 records
- Built backend API that can filter prices based on time, visualize costs, and prevent fraud through NextJs’s Authentication feature
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Rust · Pandas (Software) · Networking · Operating Systems · Rust (Programming Language)
